verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs clearly document next-day, 2-day, and standard 4-day payroll processing, confirming fast direct deposit payroll for employees (gusto-docs-3, gusto-docs-15) as part of its broader payroll platform (gusto-docs-44). However, a hands-on account reports the 2-day payroll speed was capped at ~$60k regardless of bank balance, requiring recurring manual support exceptions to scale — a concrete real-world limitation on the claimed speed (gusto-comm-12). Missing for 10: independent confirmation that caps don't apply broadly, and documentation of any minimum thresholds/eligibility criteria for 'qualifying companies' mentioned in docs-15.
